text_simplified:
Imam Malik ibn Anas (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "Refinement is only Allah's refinement, and goodness is only Allah's goodness."
Shaykh Muhammad ibn Salih al-Uthaymin (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "You do not possess guidance for your son's heart, but you must take the means, direct him to good, and ask Allah to grant him guidance and steadfastness."
